name: Bilia AB (publ)
summary: Bilia AB (publ) operates as a full-service supplier for car ownership in Sweden, Norway, Luxembourg, and Belgium. The company operates through Service, Car, and Fuel segments. It provides service, repair, fuel, car wash, rental cars, wheel and tyres, rim repair, car accessories, car care, paint work, glass repair and replacement and repair, car accessories, and other services. The company also offers car servicing and repair, spare parts, and wheel storage. In addition, it provides washing and refueling services under the Tanka, OKQ8, and Tvätta brands.
